data.title: 中野一花 · 街角可丽饼的双人分享
data.description: 秋意渐浓的林荫大道旁，一花双手小心捧着盛满草莓与奶油的可丽饼递到少年唇边，笑眼弯弯地发出俏皮的分享邀请。
data.action: holding crepe forward, offering food, leaning in
data.promptProse: On a golden autumn tree-lined street, Nakano Ichika offers a strawberry cream crepe directly toward the viewer with both hands. Her warm trench coat and joyful, sparkling smile create an intimate, charming afternoon date atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward on the autumn sidewalk, she offers a strawberry crepe with a sweet beaming smile.
